intent: Build a habit tracker with streaks, a calendar view and dark mode.

spec.goal: Get a habit tracker app that tracks streaks, offers a calendar view and supports dark mode.
spec.deliverable: A working habit tracker app with streak tracking, a calendar view and a dark mode.
constraints: Must include streak tracking for habits.
done_criteria: A user can create habits and mark them as done.
Streaks are shown for each habit and update as habits are completed.
A calendar view displays habit completion by date.
The app can be switched to a dark mode.
spec.summary: You want a habit tracker app that shows streaks, has a calendar view and offers a dark mode.
